overview_description.description: Rhizome AI is a generative AI-based regulatory intelligence platform for life sciences teams. It provides access to and analysis of data from global health authorities, including the FDA and EMA. The system integrates and updates datasets such as ClinicalTrials.gov, CTIS, and pre-approval therapeutics databases to deliver current regulatory information. It also organizes regulatory data into structured summaries with verified sources for decision-making in drug development and regulatory work.
